description: Servo-U ventilator Edi waveform OCR engine (resolution-independent; frames are read at 1280x720 internally; coordinates are written in pixels of the analyzed video). 0.2.0: numbers are read on every frame by digit templates (EasyOCR only as a fallback); breaths are the ventilator's display updates (Cdyn/VTe), never merged or split; each breath is rebuilt from its last image using the pen tip tracked on every frame (Frames.csv Sweep_X), like the Hamilton engine, from images kept during initial_ocr; patient triggers come from the white part of the traces (Trigger, Trigger_Source); 0.2.1: Breaths.csv values have the plain name for the breath's own value (VTe, VTi, Ppeak, Cdyn, EdiPeak, TiTtot) and the suffix _displayed for what the screen showed (up to 0.2.0: Real_VTe etc.). v1.3-v1.5 (0.1.x): optimal-path waveform points, abnormal frames in initial_ocr, engine_api 3, faster region-only processing.

alerts.name: Fragment
alerts.label: Cut at the start or end of the recording

alerts.name: Two_Breath
alerts.label: At least 1.5x the neighbouring breaths (possibly a missed display update)

alerts.name: Short
alerts.label: At most half the neighbouring breaths (possibly a misread display update)

alerts.name: Long
alerts.label: Longer than one sweep; only the part still on the screen

alerts.name: Partial
alerts.label: End of the waveform not on the screen yet

alerts.name: Abnormal
alerts.label: Pop-up or another screen on the image of the breath (no waveform)

alerts.name: Disconnect
alerts.label: VTe about 0 with VTi of 1000 ml or more and Cdyn "***" for 3 or more breaths (leak about 100%; possibly a disconnected circuit)
